settings.hero_body: Some evenings call for familiar faces and no conversation required. Eight colorful companions make a playful addition to the corner where you like to do your own thing.
settings.detail_title: Eight designs, down to the details.
settings.detail_body: Look closely at the embroidered faces, colorful hoods and little brown paws. Every companion brings its own silhouette to the collection you have been picturing.
settings.final_title: Keep the evening on your terms.
settings.final_body: Bring all eight into your favorite place to spend a quiet night.
settings.moods_body: Every pictured companion is included, with no favorite to leave out.
settings.personality_title: Good company for your own kind of evening.
settings.personality_body: A book, a game or simply time at home: put the crew where you like to settle in. All eight can stay together while you enjoy an evening at your own pace.
settings.hand_note: Eight companions. Every pictured design included.
settings.personality_eyebrow: Good company for your own kind of evening.
